items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: And he said that Hammond was very enthusiastic about it, but that's the last I ever heard.

ctx.x: Was that a Finger Buster just to piano solo that you used to?

No, we had a little orchestra. Orchester there. Orchester, yes. He had to, that's when he rested. It was when the orchestra took up and was playing full blast. Why, he'd rest. And he said, I didn't think he could make it. And he said that Hammond was very enthusiastic about it, but that's the last I ever heard.
Well, I wonder, did he ever, wonder what ever happened to the takes on those, that session that he tried out with? That must have been from Columbia, wasn't it?
